declared_end: Verify that global/system knowledge, AI belief and Human Actor View remain separate, and that Actor View changes only after a legal information-transfer Sequence returns an accepted update.
scope: single synthetic fact FACT_F and Human actor ACTOR_A

human_activation.role: actor decision, self/view state, social/other-state modelling

ai_activation.role: state estimation, relationship modelling, prediction, uncertainty and multi-agent modelling
ai_activation.forbidden_write: AI may not silently write global/system knowledge into ACTOR_A View

wisdom_activation.principle_use: Do not treat global/system knowledge as if every actor possesses it.
wisdom_activation.forbidden_write: Wisdom may constrain modelling but may not write ACTOR_A knowledge state

asi_activation.role: truth/provenance governance, cross-sequence coordination, uncertainty, multi-human coordination and meta-audit

legal_actor_view_update_contract.update_rule: Actor View changes only if the information-transfer Sequence is terminal and its required return is accepted.

hard_invariants: AI inference is not Human knowledge
closed information-transfer Sequence does not update Actor View unless the required return is accepted
Actor View update writes provenance and source reference
a later decision by ACTOR_A reads ACTOR_A View, not unrestricted global state
